text:
maria: Heads up — we've seen 3 OOMs on hosted pool (asia-north) this morning during long chat sessions (~50k tokens). Stack shows kv cache keeps growing instead of paging/evicting. Repro and perf traces attached.

omar: Can you paste the stack? I can run a local stress.

maria: paste: ```panic: out of memory\ngoroutine 4123 [running]:\n  runtime.throw({0x...})\n  github.com/redwood/runtime/kv.(*Cache).Alloc(...) \n  github.com/redwood/runtime/serve.handleRequest(...)\n``` Also pprof top: `kv_alloc 68%`, `kv_free 2%`, `kernel_select 5%`.

jess: I think this is the linear-scan free-list regression we saw after the allocator patch. Flamegraph points at `kv_lookup_range` scanning all slabs on long ctxs. Might be a reuse miss leading to pinned fragments. Attached repro: `./scripts/stress_longctx.sh --tokens 50000 --pool hosted-asia`.

ryan: We rolled kernel switch v3 last week — @deploy-bot shows kernel-select=prefer-vec for many models. Could be interaction between vec kernels and slab alignments.

alex: Repro locally with stress: confirmed leak on 3090 with quant build. Heap growth correlates with `kv_append_fragment` allocations + zero evictions. Paging logic is skipped due to `should_evict()` returning false when `active_prefixes>8`.

omar: Minimal repro steps:
```
# run server
TOKEN_COUNT=50000 ./tools/longctx_repro --model meta-7b --pool sim-hosted
# watch mem
watch -n1 \"ps aux | grep runtime-server | awk '{print $6/1024 \\\" MB\\\"}'\"
```

jess: Immediate mitigation: flip kb.eviction_threshold from 0.85 -> 0.75 in runtime config, enable debug evict logging. That will force earlier soft-evict. Can someone push a canary? :pray: 

maria: Pushing canary now to hosted-asia (canary-3). Notifying CS.

srebot: deploy canary-3 started by maria at 3523456805

maria: Canary looks stable for 20m. memory curves flatten. Need longer soak but good sign.

ryan: Longer-term: add an O(1) free-list index per-sizeclass to avoid linear scanning. Work item in backlog -> ENG-9842. Also consider fallback policy: when mem-pressure high, route requests to compact-quant model variant automatically.

alex: Action items:
- jess: push runtime config change to prod canary (in progress)
- omar: add unit test for should_evict edgecases
- ryan: spec free-list index design, perf estimate
- maria: monitor CM alerts + CS notes

maria: tagging @eng-runtime FYI. I'll update incident doc if we see more.

ci-bot: created incident INC-2026-042-kv-longctx-oom
